subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Mandate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Mandate**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Mandate **means an official order or commission to do something. (शासनादेश)
 
• Marked option **Command **means to give an authoritative or peremptory order. (आदेश)
 
• It is clear that '**Mandate**' and '**Command**' are similar in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 4.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Question**: A matter requiring resolution or discussion. (सवाल)
 
• **Request**: An act of asking politely or formally for something. (अनुरोध)
 
• **Enquire**: Ask for information from someone. (पूछताछ)
